## App Router & Server Component Compliance

- [ ] CHK001 All components Server Components by default unless interactivity is required
- [ ] CHK002 Leaf Client Components annotated with `'use client'` strictly at component boundaries
- [ ] CHK003 No leakage of server secrets to client side (verify environment variables)
- [ ] CHK004 Data fetching done inside Server Components or handled securely via Server Actions

## TypeScript & Type Safety

- [ ] CHK005 Strict mode enabled, zero occurrences of `any` types or unsafe type assertions
- [ ] CHK006 Props, API requests, response formats, and form inputs strictly typed
- [ ] CHK007 Proper validation schemas (Zod) defined and executed at the boundaries (Server Actions)

## UI & Accessibility (WCAG AA)

- [ ] CHK008 Interactive elements keyboard accessible (tabs, focus states visible)
- [ ] CHK009 Dynamic content has aria-labels and roles where necessary for screen readers
- [ ] CHK010 Viewports responsive on standard Mobile, Tablet, and Desktop screen widths
- [ ] CHK011 Color contrast ratios conform to WCAG 2.1 AA requirements

## Performance & Optimization

- [ ] CHK012 Fonts loaded using `next/font` with swap display settings
- [ ] CHK013 Images sized, cached, and loaded using `next/image` with layout/priority properties
- [ ] CHK014 Routing links use native prefetching via `next/link`
- [ ] CHK015 Route updates leverage cache refresh APIs (`import { refresh } from 'next/cache'`) where appropriate
